newsitem.title: USA: President Casinos trims Q4 Feb 28 loss.
newsitem.headline: President Casinos trims Q4 Feb 28 loss.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said Friday its losses in the fourth quarter ended February 28 shrank from a year ago, even though revenues were lowered compared to last year.

The gaming facilities developer reported a loss of $5.1 million, or $0.17 a share, versus a loss of $47.1 million, or $1.56, in the same period in 1996. The year-ago figure included an asset impairment charge of $13.8 million and a $24.3-million charge for the establishment of a valuation allowance on deferred tax status, the company said.
Revenues in the period fell to $43.4 million from $43.7 million in the first quarter of 1996.
President Casinos shares were unchanged Friday at 17/32.
